context: A uni student listens to a teen friend's self-confidence story
purpose: Teach: につれて/につれ/おもしろかっ/めったに/浮かべ/挑む/如何に/太っ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 先輩、最近、自信つくにつれて、行動も増えてきました。
lines.en: Senpai, I've noticed that as I got more confident, I started doing more things.
lines.style: Warm admission, a little vulnerable. Slight pause before the second clause—collecting herself before saying something true. Direct eye contact.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: いいね。年を重ねるにつれ、視野が広がっていくんだよ。
lines.en: That's good. As you get older, your view of the world just keeps expanding.
lines.style: Encouraging, steady voice. Leans back slightly, genuinely pleased. Not lecturing—just recognizing something he's seen happen. Slight nod.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 前は、めったに笑顔浮かべなかったんですが…。
lines.en: Before, I barely smiled at all.
lines.style: Quiet, almost to herself. Looking down briefly. The kind of honesty that costs a little to say out loud. Soft delivery.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 昔のサクラ、今からするとおもしろかったね。
lines.en: But honestly—looking back now, old Sakura was kind of great.
lines.style: Gentle tease, real warmth underneath. Small smile in his voice. Teasing in a way that actually builds her up. Unhurried.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 冬に太ってしまって、ダイエット挑むつもりです。
lines.en: I put on weight over winter, so I'm thinking about trying to diet.
lines.style: Practical statement, but slightly self-conscious. A tiny bit of deflection—moving past vulnerability quickly. Matter-of-fact tone.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 如何に楽しみながら続けるか、それが大事だよ。
lines.en: The thing is—how you keep enjoying it while you're at it. That's really what counts.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly slower pace. Warmth in the voice, almost like he's handed her something important. Finality without dismissal.
